items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: The interviewer asks 'what was her name? The person you got married to? Uh, Beulah Walker was her name.' The interviewee confirms 'De Beulah Walker? Yeah.'
